Triangle strips use the native normal-X ADC restart bit; runtime clipping and winding are not emulated.
Default stock-named parts use native skeleton rest positions; runtime customization is not emulated.
Native local XYZ Euler frames compose with parent rest transforms; runtime joint animation is not emulated.
Native rims and tires use default source handles and static rest sizing; wheel rotation, camber and deformation are not emulated.
Display NORMAL is face-derived; original VIF normal, color and UV lanes are retained separately without asserting native shading.
Authored drop_shadow effect meshes are retained as dormant nativeEffects nodes outside the default scene; runtime projection and activation are pending recovery.

Textures: PCK-embedded 256x256 PSMT8 images and shared 8-bit .tex files are decoded; native shader passes, environment/specular/metal-flake layers, paint colour and runtime logo/decal textures are not emulated.
Native shader categories identify surfaces; game shader behavior is not emulated.
Diffuse images are decoded only where a material lists one; environment, specular, metal-flake, paint, licence-plate and runtime logo slots are not.
Neutral inspection factors are display choices, not recovered native paint colors.
Colored-glass factors translate the native tint vector; GS shading is not emulated.
Explicit native customization RGB vectors are selectable static translations; their runtime precedence over CarCfg paint presets is unresolved.
CarCfg paint preset indices and palette coordinates are retained, but the preset-to-RGB conversion and current factory default are not established.
Native RGB channels are carried unscaled; game colour space, finish, gradients, metal flake and runtime vinyl/decal compositing are not emulated.

Direct carpaint materials and materials sharing the runtime paint slot (__metalflake__) receive paint variants; composite wrapper shader selection and native per-material colour execution remain unresolved.
Wheel, caliper, window, neon and separate secondary-paint channel bindings are not recovered. Native finish names are retained without invented PBR finish controls.

Native PS2 tire alpha test is ALWAYS and its base pass overwrites RGB; original image alpha controls additive reflection, never visibility. Recovered VU coordinates and GS blending use the original San Diego midnight garage capture, panorama and specular-copy translation; complete hardware rasterization and runtime frame context remain outside this translation.
